pull_requests.title: fix(payment): increase DB connection pool size to handle peak traffic
pull_requests.body:
## Problem
We've been seeing intermittent connection pool timeouts during peak traffic (PAY-9780). The current pool size of 30 is insufficient.

## Changes
- Increased `maximumPoolSize` from 30 to 50
- Increased `max_lifetime` from 600000ms (10 min) to 3600000ms (60 min) to reduce churn
- Set `minimumIdle` to 0 (lazy initialization - only create connections when needed)
- Removed `connectionTimeout` override (using default 30s)

## Testing
- Load tested locally with k6: 500 rps, 0 errors
- Staging deployment successful

## Risk
- Medium: DB connection limit on postgres-primary is 100. With pool size 50 and read-replica also consuming ~40 connections, we may approach the limit under peak load. Recommend monitoring after deploy.
pull_requests.author: mike.johnson@company.com
